cs.t: I had a 720 and loved it more than any other device I've ever had. It really changed my workflow and I used it daily for about ten years. I finally had to move away from it because connectivity and compatibility became too much of an issue. These days, a 13" slim notebook with a good suspend mode is nearly as convenient as that 720, so I doubt I would be interested even if an updated version was available. The 200LX had two big draws, the specialized keyboard and the ability to run desktop software, but the bigger keyboard on the 690/720 allowed touch typing, which was the biggest thing for me.
